description: This Python source file provides helper functions for managing guardrail configurations in the Litellm project, including permission and metadata checks for modifying guardrails and applying specific guardrail callbacks based on team metadata, API keys, and request data.

classes.name: GuardrailItem
classes.description: A class representing guardrail configuration, including associated callback methods.

classes.name: LiteLLM_TeamTable
classes.description: A class representing team metadata, used to determine guardrail modification permissions.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: A class representing user API key permissions, used to determine guardrail access.

methods.name: bool can_modify_guardrails(team_obj: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable])
methods.description: Determines if guardrails can be modified for a given team object based on its metadata.

methods.name: bool should_proceed_based_on_metadata(data: dict, guardrail_name: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific guardrail should be applied based on the request's metadata.

methods.name: bool should_proceed_based_on_api_key( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, guardrail_name: str )
methods.description: Checks whether a specific guardrail should be applied based on the user's API key permissions.

ctags.name: should_proceed_based_on_metadata
ctags.pattern: /^async def should_proceed_based_on_metadata(data: dict, guardrail_name: str) -> bool:$/
